title: Touchpoint Thursday — outreach scratch
content:
Date: Thu 2026-05-27
Timezone: PT (base) — calling window 9:30a-2:30p PT
Goals today: 10 live touches (calls + voicemails), 6 follow-up emails, 2 demos scheduled.

---
Daily quick notes / mental checklist
- Preview: focus on Mid-Market fintech and e-comm with latency pain points.
- Toggle: prioritize Dedicated inquiries first (higher ACV).
- Quick KPIs: response rate target 12% today, demo conversion 20% of replies.
- Remind: mention Redwood Optimize suggestion engine + dedicated SLA for demos.

---
Call list (priority order) — quick snapshot
1) Ana Mercado | Head of AI | FinEdge (SF) | TZ: PT | Stage: 1st touch (inbound trial) | Priority: High
 - Notes: trial on hosted API hitting 350ms p99 spikes, asked re: dedicated capacity.
 - Script bullets: "saw performance in trial — we can show tail latency improvements with Dedicated and caching".
 - Next action: Call at 10:00a PT, goal: qualify throughput and propose demo cluster sizing.
 - Outcome: -------

2) DevOps: Rajesh Patel | Sr Eng Mgr | CartLeap | TZ: PT | Stage: follow-up | Priority: Med
 - Notes: asked about VPC private deployment + KMS. CC'd security.
 - Script bullets: "private control plane + HSM integrations — quick checklist I can send".
 - Next action: Email w/ checklist (send by 11:30a).

3) Charlotte King | ML Platform | Adoy Labs | TZ: ET | Stage: demo booked | Priority: High
 - Notes: demo 5/29 1:00p ET. Wants quantization / memory footprint examples.
 - Prep: pull 3 model-size comparison slides, example perf numbers for 2k tokens.
 - Action: prep deck + confirm 5/29 calendar invite.

4) Lukas Nguyen | CTO | ShopHalo | TZ: CET | Stage: cold outreach warmed by SDR | Priority: Low
 - Notes: retail capacity planning — likely Q3.
 - Action: leave voicemail and send intro note.

5) Megan Short | Product | HealthQ | TZ: PT | Stage: pricing questions | Priority: Med
 - Notes: wants predictable billing for heavy embedding workloads.
 - Action: schedule 30m sync next week; send sample pricing scenarios.

---
Open follow-ups (urgent)
- CONV-294: follow up with legal procurement for Acme Health (docs requested). Slack DM purchaser: @maya.patel
- Send usage breakdown (tokens by route) to finance-request@acme — have template ready.
- Re-run cost calc for CartLeap with 75 QPS peak, 50ms avg token latency — include dedicated vs hosted monthly.

---
Copy/paste email templates (short)
1) Quick follow-up (post-voicemail)
Subject: Quick follow-up on Redwood capacity options
Hi {FirstName},
I left a voicemail — wanted to follow up with a short note. Based on your trial metrics it looks like tail latency is the main blocker. We can run a short Dedicated pilot to validate latency and cost. Can you do a 30-min sync this week?
Best,
Omar

2) Pricing sketch (attach simple table)
Subject: Pricing sketch — Dedicated vs Hosted (example)
Hi {FirstName},
Attaching a quick sketch comparing monthly costs for your workload at 75 QPS and 2k tokens/session. Would be happy to walk through numbers — 20–30min.
Cheers,
Omar

---
Triage / quick notes from yesterday's calls
- Acme Health: procurement asked for SOC2 artifacts — Maya sending. Status: waiting on legal review.
- FinEdge: got intro to ML lead (Ana) — high interest in canary rollouts and model pinning.
- CartLeap: engineering asked about KV cache behavior for chat sessions >10k tokens. Need SRE example.

---
To-dos (ordered)
- [ ] 10:00a call — Ana Mercado (prepare 1-pager on Dedicated sizing)
- [ ] Email Rajesh Patel KMS checklist (template ready)
- [ ] Prep quantization examples + slides for Charlotte demo
- [ ] Update pricing sketch for HealthQ (two scenarios)
- [ ] Drop voicemail for Lukas + send intro email
- [ ] Add follow-up reminders in HubSpot for all touched leads (set next step & due date)
- [ ] Update playbook note: add example KV-cache FAQ (SRE input)

---
Questions / open blockers
- Need SRE snippet about cache TTLs for long chat sessions — ask @ramon.ruiz for sample config.
- Does Finance have a standard price-break for >$100k ARR? (ping @maya)
- Can we get a quick recorded demo clip (60s) showing rollout/canary UI for GTM collateral? (product/console team)

---
Random jot: short pitch lines (1-liners)
- "Redwood makes inference predictable — same API, faster p99, lower cost with cache + batching."
- "If you want fewer surprises on bill and latency, try a short Dedicated pilot — we size it and you measure."

---
End-of-day wrap (to fill)
- Touches completed: __ /10
- Replies recorded: __
- Demos scheduled: __
- Notes to self: capture any objection patterns (pricing, security, integration) and add to playbook.

---
Log / audit (links)
- HubSpot: create/update contact + add call notes (TODAY)
- Confluence: outbound playbook link above
- Jira: create ticket if engineering questions need escalation (ex: KV cache TTL examples)

---
Scratch/brainstorm (throwaway)
- Run a 2-week "Dedicated mini-pilot" promo for mid-market — offer first month at X% off + SRE onboarding slot. Test conversion.
- Idea: short GIF showing p99 drops after enabling KV cache (before/after). Good for email sequence.

(rough, may tidy later)
